item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37: Pod-Level Resource Managers graduated to Beta
item.description:
Kubernetes v1.37 graduates Pod-Level Resource Managers to Beta, disabled by default behind the PodLevelResourceManagers feature gate. Kubelet’s Topology Manager, CPU Manager, and Memory Manager can now use pod-level resource declarations for NUMA-aware placement, and the PodResources API reports top-level CPU and memory assignments.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37: Memory QoS Graduates to Beta
item.description:
Kubernetes v1.37 makes Memory QoS Beta and turns it on by default, but it does not change runtime behavior unless you explicitly set throttling or reservation fields. The main config change is that memoryThrottlingFactor now defaults to null, so existing clusters will not start writing memory.high unless they already set it.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog
